blocks.zh: 附錄與 2021 年全球問卷調查
blocks.en: Appendices and the 2021 Global Survey

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 熟悉稽查員可能要求提供的 37 項文件清單，並能依文件性質進行分類與優先準備
blocks.en: Become familiar with the list of 37 documents an inspector may request, and be able to classify them by nature and prioritize their preparation

blocks.zh: 理解 2021 年 PDA 全球問卷調查的設計方法、受訪者組成與調查侷限性
blocks.en: Understand the design methodology, respondent composition and limitations of the 2021 PDA global survey

blocks.zh: 分析調查中反映的遠端稽查主要挑戰，並連結至 CDMO 實務整改方向
blocks.en: Analyze the main challenges of remote inspections reflected in the survey and link them to practical improvement directions for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 評估各國主管機關（FDA、EMA、MHRA、TGA 等）在遠端稽查中的行為模式差異
blocks.en: Evaluate the differences in behavior patterns among national authorities (FDA, EMA, MHRA, TGA, etc.) in remote inspections

blocks.zh: 根據調查後的業界學習，制定 CDMO 面對首次遠端稽查的準備行動計畫
blocks.en: Based on post-survey industry learning, develop an action plan for a CDMO's preparation for its first remote inspection

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 — Documents That May Be Requested by an Inspector (附錄 1：稽查員可能要求之文件清單)
blocks.en: Appendix 1 - Documents That May Be Requested by an Inspector

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：文件雙分類法
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Two-Category Classification of Documents

blocks.zh: 本附錄 37 項文件可依性質分為兩大類，方便 CDMO 團隊制定準備策略：
blocks.en: The 37 documents in this appendix can be divided into two broad categories by nature, which helps a CDMO team develop its preparation strategy:

blocks.zh: (A) 品質系統文件（Quality System Documents，第 1–14 項）：涵蓋 GMP 認證、CAPA、APR、變更控制、偏差管理、召回程序、供應商清單等。這些文件反映公司的品質管理體系（QMS）整體架構，屬於每次稽查必備的「核心基底」。
blocks.en: (A) Quality System Documents (items 1–14): covering GMP certification, CAPA, APR, change control, deviation management, recall procedures, supplier lists and more. These documents reflect the overall architecture of the company's quality management system (QMS) and are the "core foundation" needed for every inspection.

blocks.zh: (B) 技術與製造文件（Technical / Manufacturing Documents，第 15–37 項）：包含廠房平面圖、MBR、穩定性研究、EM 趨勢、Site Master File、APS（無菌製程模擬）、CCS（污染控制策略）等。這些文件的深度與廣度往往是稽查員評估技術能力的關鍵依據。
blocks.en: (B) Technical / Manufacturing Documents (items 15–37): including site layout drawings, MBR, stability studies, EM trends, the Site Master File, APS (aseptic process simulation), CCS (contamination control strategy) and more. The depth and breadth of these documents are often the key basis on which inspectors evaluate technical capability.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 稽查就緒三層分級
blocks.en: Practical Application: A Three-Tier Inspection-Readiness Model for CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO 應依文件的緊急性與更新頻率建立「三層備查制度」：
blocks.en: A CDMO should establish a "three-tier readiness system" based on the urgency and update frequency of documents:

blocks.zh: 第一層：隨時備妥 需維持在電子系統中最新版本，48 小時內可提供：
blocks.en: Tier 1: Always ready Keep the latest version in the electronic system, available within 48 hours:

blocks.zh: Site Master File（第 28 項）— 每年更新，稽查前確認版本正確
blocks.en: Site Master File (item 28) - updated annually; confirm the version is correct before the inspection

blocks.zh: GMP 認證書（第 2 項）— 掃描存放雲端共享資料夾
blocks.en: GMP certificate (item 2) - scanned and stored in a cloud shared folder

blocks.zh: QMS SOPs（第 5、7、8、9、11、12、13 項）— 確保均為已審核現行版本
blocks.en: QMS SOPs (items 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13) - make sure all are approved, current versions

blocks.zh: CAPA 追蹤表（第 3 項）— 維持即時狀態，附上完成佐證
blocks.en: CAPA tracking log (item 3) - kept in real-time status, with evidence of completion attached

blocks.zh: 第二層：2 週內可備齊 需確認資料存放位置，但不必每天更新：
blocks.en: Tier 2: Ready within 2 weeks The storage location must be confirmed, but the documents need not be updated daily:

blocks.zh: MBR、製程驗證報告（第 18、32 項）
blocks.en: MBR, process validation reports (items 18, 32)

blocks.zh: 分析方法驗證報告（第 24 項）
blocks.en: Analytical method validation reports (item 24)

blocks.zh: APS（Media Fill）結果彙整（第 29 項）
blocks.en: APS (media fill) results summary (item 29)

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢報告（第 27 項）
blocks.en: EM trend reports (item 27)

blocks.zh: 第三層：從檔案庫調閱 歷史資料，調閱前需確認可識別性：
blocks.en: Tier 3: Retrieved from the archive Historical data; confirm identifiability before retrieval:

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究完整數據（第 23 項）
blocks.en: Complete stability study data (item 23)

blocks.zh: 設備驗證歷史記錄（第 31 項）
blocks.en: Equipment qualification history records (item 31)

blocks.zh: 再製程/再加工批次清單（第 26 項）
blocks.en: List of reprocessed/reworked batches (item 26)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CCS 列入清單的意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Significance of CCS Being on the List

blocks.zh: 第 37 項「污染控制策略（Contamination Control Strategy, CCS）」被明確列入本文件清單，與 2022 年 EU GMP Annex 1（無菌製程指引）的要求形成直接呼應。Annex 1 第 2.1 條明確要求廠商建立全廠性的 CCS 文件。
blocks.en: Item 37, Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), is explicitly included in this document list, directly echoing the requirements of the 2022 EU GMP Annex 1 (sterile manufacturing guidance). Annex 1 clause 2.1 explicitly requires manufacturers to establish a site-wide CCS document.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著 CCS 已從「最佳實踐建議」升格為「稽查員會主動索取的文件」。若 CCS 尚未建立或內容薄弱，將成為稽查中的重大缺失。CCS 應涵蓋：廠房設計、人員培訓、環境監控、無菌操作規範、清潔驗證、供應商管理等各層面的污染控制措施。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means CCS has been upgraded from a "best practice recommendation" to a "document inspectors will request proactively." If a CCS has not been established or its content is weak, it will become a major deficiency in an inspection. The CCS should cover contamination control measures across all aspects: facility design, personnel training, environmental monitoring, aseptic operating practices, cleaning validation, supplier management and more.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：37 項文件 = 醫院的病歷系統
blocks.en: Analogy: The 37 Documents = A Hospital's Medical Record System

blocks.zh: 想像一位新任主治醫師在接手病人前要查閱的資料：過去的診斷記錄（CAPA/偏差）、目前的治療計畫（MBR/製程驗證）、藥物過敏史（供應商清單）、手術記錄（設備驗證）、感染控制計畫（CCS）……這些資料不是在主治醫師到來時才開始準備的——它們必須是日常管理的一部分，隨時完整可查。
blocks.en: Imagine the information a newly assigned attending physician must review before taking over a patient: past diagnosis records (CAPA/deviations), the current treatment plan (MBR/process validation), drug allergy history (supplier list), surgical records (equipment qualification) and the infection control plan (CCS)... None of this is prepared only when the physician arrives; it must be part of daily management and always complete and retrievable.

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查的特殊性在於：稽查員看不到現場，文件品質本身就成為「現場狀態」的代理人。文件越清晰、越有條理，稽查員對現場的信心就越高。
blocks.en: What is special about a remote inspection is that the inspector cannot see the site, so the quality of the documents themselves becomes the proxy for the "state of the site." The clearer and better organized the documents, the higher the inspector's confidence in the site.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若稽查員在遠端稽查開始前 48 小時要求提供「Site Master File 與 CAPA 追蹤清單」，您的 CDMO 目前能在多少時間內完成電子版交付？有哪些瓶頸需要改善？
blocks.en: If an inspector asks for the "Site Master File and CAPA tracking list" 48 hours before the remote inspection starts, how quickly can your CDMO currently deliver the electronic versions? What bottlenecks need to be improved?

blocks.zh: CCS 文件是否已在貴公司正式建立？它目前屬於獨立文件還是分散於各 SOP 之中？如何整合成稽查員易於閱讀的單一文件？
blocks.en: Has your company formally established a CCS document? Is it currently a standalone document or spread across various SOPs? How can it be consolidated into a single document that inspectors can easily read?

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 — 2021 PDA Survey: Methodology (附錄 2：調查方法論)
blocks.en: Appendix 2 - 2021 PDA Survey: Methodology

blocks.zh: 重點提示：調查時間點的歷史背景
blocks.en: Key Point: The Historical Context of the Survey Timing

blocks.zh: 本問卷於 2020 年 11 月 9–24 日開放填答，距離 COVID-19 疫情正式爆發（2020 年 3 月 WHO 宣布大流行）僅約 8 個月。這意味著大多數受訪者的遠端稽查經驗非常有限，許多公司甚至仍在摸索中。
blocks.en: The questionnaire was open for responses from 9–24 November 2020, only about 8 months after the COVID-19 outbreak formally began (the WHO declared a pandemic in March 2020). This means most respondents had very limited remote inspection experience, and many companies were still finding their way.

blocks.zh: 因此，本調查反映的是「遠端稽查的史前時代」——業界尚未建立完整的操作規範與技術基礎設施。2021 年後，業界的準備度已大幅提升，遠端稽查工具（Teams、Zoom、SharePoint 文件室）的使用也更加成熟。閱讀本調查結果時，需要將這個時間背景納入考量。
blocks.en: The survey therefore reflects the "prehistoric era of remote inspections," when the industry had not yet established complete operating norms and technical infrastructure. After 2021 industry readiness improved significantly, and the use of remote inspection tools (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint document rooms) became more mature. This time context must be taken into account when reading the survey results.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：拉丁美洲缺席的影響
blocks.en: Key Point: The Impact of Latin America's Absence

blocks.zh: 調查明確指出「Latin America was not represented（拉丁美洲無受訪者）」。這在解讀調查結果時是一個重要的侷限性，因為：
blocks.en: The survey explicitly states that "Latin America was not represented." This is an important limitation when interpreting the results, because:

blocks.zh: Anvisa（巴西）作為全球十大監管機構之一，在問卷中的回答比例為 0%（第 9 題），遠端稽查規範相對較不成熟
blocks.en: Anvisa (Brazil), one of the world's ten largest regulators, had a 0% response share in the questionnaire (Q9), and its remote inspection framework is relatively less mature

blocks.zh: 許多生產熱帶疾病藥物的廠商位於此區域，遠端稽查對他們的意義可能不同
blocks.en: Many manufacturers of tropical disease drugs are located in this region, so remote inspection may mean something different to them

blocks.zh: 在拉丁美洲營運的 CDMO，在規劃遠端稽查準備時，應單獨評估 Anvisa 及各國主管機關的具體要求，不能直接套用本調查結論
blocks.en: A CDMO operating in Latin America should separately assess the specific requirements of Anvisa and each country's authority when planning remote inspection preparation, and should not apply this survey's conclusions directly

blocks.zh: 受訪者組成解析
blocks.en: Analysis of Respondent Composition

blocks.zh: QA 佔比高達 43.4%，是最主要的受訪族群，這合理反映了稽查準備工作由 QA 主導的現實。值得注意的是：
blocks.en: QA accounts for as much as 43.4%, making it the largest respondent group, which reasonably reflects the reality that inspection preparation is led by QA. It is worth noting that:

blocks.zh: 製造（Manufacturing Operations，7.5%）的比例相對低，但遠端稽查時製造部門需承擔的實際操作負擔（協助廠區虛擬導覽、即時調閱記錄）相當大
blocks.en: Manufacturing Operations (7.5%) is a relatively low share, yet the actual operational burden on manufacturing during a remote inspection (supporting virtual site tours, retrieving records in real time) is considerable

blocks.zh: QC 僅 1.9%，顯示實驗室層面的聲音在這份調查中代表性不足；而稽查中 QC 實驗室往往是重點稽查區域
blocks.en: QC is only 1.9%, showing that the voice of the laboratory level is under-represented in this survey, even though the QC laboratory is often a key inspection area

blocks.zh: 超過半數（51.9%）的受訪廠址有 250 人以上，大型廠偏重；小型 CDMO 的經驗可能有所不同
blocks.en: More than half (51.9%) of the respondent sites have 250 or more employees, so the sample is skewed toward large sites; the experience of small CDMOs may differ

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 — Key Survey Findings (問卷調查核心結果)
blocks.en: Appendix 2 - Key Survey Findings

blocks.zh: 核心概念：問卷五大核心發現
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Key Findings of the Survey

blocks.zh: 綜合所有問卷題目，以下五點是對 CDMO 最具實務意義的核心洞察：
blocks.en: Taking all the survey questions together, the following five points are the insights of greatest practical significance to a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查已成主流（Q7）：截至 2020 年底，已有 66% 的受訪者參與或支援過遠端稽查，比例遠高於預期，顯示疫情加速了遠端稽查的普及化。
blocks.en: Remote inspection has become mainstream (Q7): by the end of 2020, 66% of respondents had participated in or supported a remote inspection, a much higher proportion than expected, showing that the pandemic accelerated the spread of remote inspection.

blocks.zh: 視訊為最常見模式（Q8）：74.2% 為完全遠端視訊方式，41.9% 為混合模式，35.5% 為純文件桌上審查（Desktop Review）。三種模式各有其適用情境與準備需求。
blocks.en: Video is the most common mode (Q8): 74.2% were fully remote video, 41.9% were hybrid and 35.5% were document-only desktop review (Desktop Review). Each of the three modes has its own applicable scenarios and preparation requirements.

blocks.zh: FDA 領先全球（Q9）：FDA 以 51.6% 高居最常進行遠端稽查的主管機關，EMA 次之（35.5%）。俄羅斯（Russia）出現頻率也相當高（含於 Other 的 48.4%）。
blocks.en: The FDA leads globally (Q9): the FDA was the authority that most often conducted remote inspections at 51.6%, followed by the EMA (35.5%). Russia also appeared quite frequently (included in the 48.4% for Other).

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查往往更耗時（Q10）：超過 44.8% 的受訪者表示遠端稽查花費時間比實體稽查更長（101–200%：34.5%；超過兩倍：10.3%），顛覆了「遠端 = 省時」的直覺預期。
blocks.en: Remote inspections are often more time-consuming (Q10): more than 44.8% of respondents said remote inspections took longer than physical inspections (101–200%: 34.5%; more than double: 10.3%), overturning the intuitive expectation that "remote = time-saving."

blocks.zh: 文件需求不減反增（Q11）：26.7% 表示主管機關要求了比實體稽查更多或更詳細的資訊，且這些額外要求多半發生在稽查開始前（62.5%）及稽查過程中（62.5%）。
blocks.en: Document demands increase rather than decrease (Q11): 26.7% said the authority requested more or more detailed information than in a physical inspection, and these additional requests mostly occurred before the inspection began (62.5%) and during the inspection (62.5%).

blocks.zh: 主要挑戰：業界四大痛點
blocks.en: Main Challenges: Four Industry Pain Points

blocks.zh: 綜合 Q30 開放性回覆與其他題目，業界指出的主要挑戰可歸納為四類：
blocks.en: Combining the open-ended responses to Q30 with other questions, the main challenges identified by the industry fall into four categories:

blocks.zh: 技術限制（Technology）：IT 安全要求與稽查員使用平台不相容（如公司核准 Teams/WebEx，但稽查員要求 Zoom）；影像品質不足導致無法有效評估現場狀況；技術可被偽造的疑慮影響信任度
blocks.en: Technology: IT security requirements incompatible with the platform the inspector uses (for example, the company has approved Teams/WebEx but the inspector asks for Zoom); insufficient video quality prevents effective assessment of site conditions; concerns that the technology could be falsified affect trust

blocks.zh: 文件準備負擔（Document Preparation）：遠端稽查要求在稽查前預先提交大量電子文件；後續追加要求可延伸數週，缺乏時間限制
blocks.en: Document Preparation: remote inspections require a large volume of electronic documents to be submitted before the inspection; follow-up requests can extend over weeks with no time limit

blocks.zh: 溝通與誤解風險（Communication）：視訊會議中的溝通效率遠低於現場；觀察事項的解釋易產生歧義；稽查員無法現場目視確認操作
blocks.en: Communication: communication efficiency in video meetings is far lower than on site; explanations of observations are prone to ambiguity; inspectors cannot visually confirm operations on the spot

blocks.zh: 稽查頻率可能上升（Frequency）：因無需差旅時間，主管機關進行遠端稽查的門檻降低，部分受訪者擔心這可能導致稽查頻率增加
blocks.en: Frequency: because no travel time is needed, the threshold for authorities to conduct remote inspections is lower, and some respondents worry this may increase inspection frequency

blocks.zh: 重點提示：54% 的公司尚未就 FDA 法定要求更新 SOP
blocks.en: Key Point: 54% of Companies Have Not Yet Updated SOPs for the FDA Statutory Requirement

blocks.zh: Q31 顯示，46.3% 的受訪者表示知悉美國 21 USC 374(a)(4) 授權 FDA 在稽查前後要求提交記錄的法定條款，但尚未修訂相應的公司程序。另有 9.8% 甚至不知道有此條款存在。
blocks.en: Q31 shows that 46.3% of respondents were aware of the statutory provision 21 USC 374(a)(4), which authorizes the FDA to request records before or after an inspection, but had not yet revised the corresponding company procedures. Another 9.8% did not even know the provision existed.

blocks.zh: 對在美國 FDA 管轄範圍內運作的 CDMO 而言，這是一個重要的合規風險點。「Remote Interactive Evaluation（RIE）」並非正式稽查，但 FDA 可基於此條款要求廠商提供記錄，且結果可能影響產品上市許可（NDA/ANDA/BLA/DMF）的審核。
blocks.en: For a CDMO operating under US FDA jurisdiction, this is an important compliance risk point. A "Remote Interactive Evaluation (RIE)" is not a formal inspection, but the FDA can request records from the manufacturer under this provision, and the outcome may affect the review of marketing applications (NDA/ANDA/BLA/DMF).

blocks.zh: 實務應用：調查後學習——首次遠端稽查的 CDMO 行動清單
blocks.en: Practical Application: Post-Survey Learning - Action Checklist for a CDMO's First Remote Inspection

blocks.zh: 根據調查結果，以下是 CDMO 在準備首次遠端稽查時應採取的具體行動：
blocks.en: Based on the survey results, the following are the specific actions a CDMO should take when preparing for its first remote inspection:

blocks.zh: 稽查前（Before）：
blocks.en: Before the inspection:

blocks.zh: 建立「遠端稽查 SOP」：涵蓋文件分發流程、視訊平台選用、後台支援團隊分工、與稽查員的溝通規則（含錄影政策）
blocks.en: Establish a "remote inspection SOP" covering the document distribution process, video platform selection, division of work among the backroom support team and communication rules with the inspector (including the recording policy)

blocks.zh: 建立安全文件共享入口（Secure Portal）：71.4% 的業界選擇此模式，避免以 email 傳輸敏感文件
blocks.en: Establish a secure document-sharing portal (Secure Portal): 71.4% of the industry chose this model, avoiding the transfer of sensitive documents by email

blocks.zh: 指定一位「文件協調員（Document Coordinator）」專責即時回應文件索取請求，避免稽查員等待
blocks.en: Designate a "Document Coordinator" dedicated to responding to document requests in real time so that inspectors do not have to wait

blocks.zh: 與 IT 部門確認視訊平台的安全合規性，並事先測試頻寬與音視訊品質
blocks.en: Confirm the security compliance of the video platform with the IT department, and test bandwidth and audio/video quality in advance

blocks.zh: 針對 FDA 稽查：更新 SOP 以涵蓋 21 USC 374(a)(4) 的記錄提交要求
blocks.en: For FDA inspections: update the SOP to cover the record submission requirements of 21 USC 374(a)(4)

blocks.zh: 稽查中（During）：
blocks.en: During the inspection:

blocks.zh: 設立「後台指揮室（Backroom）」：由資深 QA 與各部門代表即時支援，確保文件請求在 30 分鐘內回應
blocks.en: Set up a "Backroom" command room: senior QA and department representatives provide real-time support to make sure document requests are answered within 30 minutes

blocks.zh: 採用雙語摘要（如適用）：若稽查員母語非英語，提前準備關鍵文件的語言摘要
blocks.en: Use bilingual summaries (where applicable): if the inspector's native language is not English, prepare language summaries of key documents in advance

blocks.zh: 每日安排 Wrap-up 會議（本文件第 II 章 Topic E.1 建議），確認當日問題均已澄清
blocks.en: Hold a Wrap-up meeting every day (recommended in Topic E.1 of Part II of this document) to confirm that all of the day's questions have been clarified

blocks.zh: 稽查後（After）：
blocks.en: After the inspection:

blocks.zh: 若收到 Written Observations，依書面回覆程序在指定期限內提交 CAPA
blocks.en: If Written Observations are received, submit the CAPA within the specified deadline according to the written response procedure

blocks.zh: 追蹤後續「Additional Information Requests」——調查顯示此類要求可延伸數週，需設立內部追蹤機制
blocks.en: Track subsequent "Additional Information Requests"; the survey shows such requests can extend over weeks, so an internal tracking mechanism is needed

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：遠端稽查的「後台指揮室」= 棒球投手丘的捕手
blocks.en: Analogy: The Remote Inspection "Backroom" = The Catcher on a Baseball Mound

blocks.zh: 在棒球比賽中，投手（現場接待稽查員的代表）面對打者（稽查員）時，背後有捕手（後台文件支援）在即時溝通。如果捕手傳球慢、配合不好，投手就會陷入被動。
blocks.en: In a baseball game, when the pitcher (the representative hosting the inspector on site) faces the batter (the inspector), the catcher (the backroom document support) communicates in real time behind him. If the catcher is slow or poorly coordinated, the pitcher is put on the defensive.

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查的本質，就是讓這個「後台–前台」的協作變得更加關鍵。現場稽查時，稽查員的問題可以在 10 步之外的檔案架上找到答案；遠端稽查時，後台需要即時從系統中調閱、轉換格式、上傳至共享入口——這整個流程的效率，直接影響稽查員對廠商的信任度。
blocks.en: The essence of a remote inspection is that it makes this backroom-frontroom collaboration even more critical. In an on-site inspection, the answer to an inspector's question can be found on a file shelf 10 steps away; in a remote inspection, the backroom must retrieve it from the system in real time, convert the format and upload it to the shared portal, and the efficiency of this whole process directly affects the inspector's trust in the manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 練習思考：稽查就緒程度自評
blocks.en: Practice Questions: Self-Assessment of Inspection Readiness

blocks.zh: 貴公司是否已有「遠端稽查 SOP」？若有，最後一次桌上演練（Tabletop Exercise）是什麼時候進行的？若無，目前指定哪個部門負責發起制定？
blocks.en: Does your company already have a "remote inspection SOP"? If so, when was the last tabletop exercise held? If not, which department is currently assigned to initiate its development?

blocks.zh: 假設 FDA 在稽查前 72 小時要求透過 FDA ESG（Electronic Submissions Gateway）提交 25 份 GMP 文件，包含 MBR、驗證報告與 OOS 記錄，貴公司的文件管理系統是否能在 24 小時內完成準備與上傳？請列出最可能的瓶頸。
blocks.en: Suppose the FDA asks, 72 hours before the inspection, for 25 GMP documents to be submitted through the FDA ESG (Electronic Submissions Gateway), including the MBR, validation reports and OOS records. Can your document management system complete the preparation and upload within 24 hours? List the most likely bottlenecks.

blocks.zh: 問卷顯示 34.5% 的受訪者表示遠端稽查比實體稽查耗時 101–200%。這對 CDMO 的稽查資源規劃（人力安排、生產排程影響）有何具體意涵？如何在稽查前就提前做好緩衝安排？
blocks.en: The survey shows that 34.5% of respondents said remote inspections took 101–200% longer than physical inspections. What are the specific implications for a CDMO's inspection resource planning (staffing, impact on the production schedule)? How can buffer arrangements be made in advance of the inspection?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 附錄 1（37 項文件清單）是遠端稽查文件準備的標準參考基礎，CDMO 應依「隨時備妥 / 2 週備齊 / 檔案調閱」三層分級進行日常管理，確保每一份文件都能在稽查員提出要求後快速且完整地提供。
blocks.en: Appendix 1 (the list of 37 documents) is the standard reference basis for remote inspection document preparation. A CDMO should manage documents day to day using the three tiers of "always ready / ready within 2 weeks / retrieved from the archive," so that every document can be provided quickly and completely once the inspector asks.

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略，第 37 項）明確列入稽查文件清單，反映 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的趨勢；CDMO 應確保 CCS 是一份獨立完整、邏輯清晰的文件，而非分散於各 SOP 中。
blocks.en: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy, item 37) is explicitly included in the inspection document list, reflecting the trend of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022); a CDMO should make sure the CCS is a standalone, complete and logically clear document rather than spread across various SOPs.

blocks.zh: 2021 PDA 調查（2020 年 11 月）是在遠端稽查仍屬新興實踐的早期進行，代表了業界在缺乏充足準備下的第一手反應，而非成熟狀態下的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: The 2021 PDA survey (November 2020) was conducted early, when remote inspection was still an emerging practice, and represents the industry's first-hand reaction with insufficient preparation rather than best practice in a mature state.

blocks.zh: FDA 是最積極採用遠端稽查的主管機關（51.6%），EMA 次之（35.5%）；CDMO 在規劃遠端稽查準備時應以這兩者的要求為基準，同時了解 MHRA、TGA、PMDA 的個別偏好。
blocks.en: The FDA is the authority that most actively uses remote inspection (51.6%), followed by the EMA (35.5%); a CDMO planning remote inspection preparation should use the requirements of these two as the baseline while also understanding the individual preferences of the MHRA, TGA and PMDA.

blocks.zh: 遠端稽查往往比實體稽查更耗時、文件需求更多：44.8% 受訪者反映耗時超過實體稽查，26.7% 反映主管機關要求更多資訊——這兩個數字提醒 CDMO 不要低估遠端稽查的資源需求。
blocks.en: Remote inspections are often more time-consuming and demand more documents than physical inspections: 44.8% of respondents said they took longer than physical inspections and 26.7% said authorities requested more information; these two figures remind a CDMO not to underestimate the resource needs of a remote inspection.

blocks.zh: 後台指揮室（Backroom）的效率是遠端稽查成敗的核心變數；建立清晰的後台–前台分工、安全文件共享平台（71.4% 業界選擇此路徑）與即時通訊機制，是 CDMO 最重要的基礎建設投資。
blocks.en: The efficiency of the Backroom is the core variable in the success or failure of a remote inspection; establishing a clear backroom-frontroom division of work, a secure document-sharing platform (71.4% of the industry chose this route) and real-time communication mechanisms is a CDMO's most important infrastructure investment.
